changes: Same frozen closed-choice role inference and initial executor prompt as v13/control.
Contract arrays may contain structured requirement objects as explicitly documented; no retrospective qualification of v13.
Withhold candidate during contract generation; then compare the existing query against the proposed contract. Preserve existing SQL unless a publicly supported defect warrants a change.
Reject unsupported reciprocity, symmetry, uniqueness and NULL assumptions. Permit read-only metadata inspection to establish join keys within40 calls.
Malformed contracts are rejected and original last query is submitted; explicitly count rejected proposals rather than claim their adoption. All48 grades remain in the comparison.
Synthetic normal+fault recovery first; one fixed48 pilot, sole unchanged controls, all earlier results retained.
Explicitly compare supported output-contract columns position by position. Wrong column count/order is a concrete defect requiring corrected SQL, not cosmetic row sorting.
v14 failed7/8 synthetic error recovery and produced no official target score; retain it rather than repeat it until passing.

Register a deterministic guard which can only permute the already-executed query plain-column list to the independently proposed contract when sets, counts and table match. No new fields, predicates, joins or SQL expressions are synthesized.
Reject set operations and any numeric ordering/grouping context; retain original SQL for unsupported shapes. Record every guard event and actual review of repaired SQL.
Reserve one of40 actions: trained model calls at most39 plus at most1 automatic SQL step; control remains the unchanged40-call branch.
Fix the unconditional Reply submit wording so preservation is explicitly conditional on every public requirement. v15 failed7/8 recovery and produced no official target score.

Before first target score, disallow retries of any already observed finite official reward or non-infrastructure failure. Only declared transport/resource failures may resume, with all failed attempts retained.
Record new episode actual model-call count, automatic SQL steps, complete API input/output usage when available, and enforce their combined40-action limit. This does not change any old receipt.
question: Can a narrow contract-grounded plain-column permutation guard fix projection-order failures without introducing new attributes or conditions?
primaryMetric: paired official reward sum difference over all 1015 locked cases
selectionRule: One registered candidate. Synthetic development checks first. One valid official receipt per ID per arm; infrastructure errors only may resume. Preserve every version and score regardless of sign. No repeated target-score selection until winning.
targetExposure: Adaptive pilot development after v3 and v4; no gold SQL or hidden expected outputs. Explicit mode correction changes the evaluation regime; old official rewards remain valid for their recorded regime.
launchCondition: No other benchmark worker; existing SQL container only; disk >=6 GiB; development checks passed; model resources safe. Do not alter active tau runtime.
fullExpansionRequires: All48 grade and role/checker consumption audits complete and positive paired reward difference over all48; retain every prior result and carry each valid pilot receipt forward once.
renderedTemplateOrigin: Human authored before v6 scores, no target gold SQL or expected outputs. Only role selection is generated by frozen weights.

templates.DIRECT_QUERY: Verify that the final query returns exactly the requested fields and entities, without invented conditions.
templates.AGGREGATION: Verify the requested counting unit, grouping level and aggregate conditions. Distinguish rows from entities, count from sum. Never add an aggregate output column unless requested.
templates.JOIN_CARDINALITY: Verify join keys against the actual schema and check whether joins multiply rows. Do not assume uniqueness, foreign keys or a need for DISTINCT without evidence.
templates.NEGATION_NULLS: Verify which entity and relationship the exclusion applies to, including NULL behavior. Do not assume a directed relation is symmetric.
templates.RANKING: Verify whether the request asks for one ranked result or all ties. Project only requested fields and use ordering or limits only as the question requires.
templates.SET_COMBINATION: Verify the question's AND/OR or set-combination meaning and duplicate semantics; do not add conditions or cosmetic sorting.
templates.FINAL_QUERY: After every inspection or diagnostic SQL statement, execute the final answer query before submit. Submit grades only the last executed query.
